searchText: The prototype is readable enough <@425274498732916736> the intent is clear. What's next? Get a version into the EIP? Forbid EOF → legacy contract creation: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/6052 (please review) Dynamic jumps and jumpdest analysis remove in EIP-4750 by <@275684146658148352>: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/6044 It also includes `NOP` in place of `JUMPDEST`. We didn't properly discussed it yet so leave your comments here for now. I may add it to the EIP-5450 but this has low priority. Feasibility is enough for now. About `PC`: what is it use for? I believe it was added to be combined with dynamic jumps (having absolute addresses) to produce position independent code snippets. So far I only saw optimizoors used it as a replacement for small pushes, e.g. `6005`. Done! See the issue for the zoom link 🙂 While PC may be useless, I would be hesitant to remove it as it doesn't present problems like dynamic jumps and self destruct. Willing to be shown a counterexample. Definitely no problems with implementing `PC` even in EVM bytecode compilers/translators (it is just a fancy constant). thanks!
